prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — sway (v.摇摆): A slender tree trunk and branches sway gently side to side in the wind, faint alternate positions.
TOP RIGHT — unsympathetic (a.不表同情的，无动于衷的): One adult remains coldly indifferent with crossed arms while a tired friend explains a problem, blank speech bubble.
BOTTOM LEFT — medical (a.医学的): A stethoscope, medical textbook with an anatomy illustration and a doctor's white coat are arranged together.
BOTTOM RIGHT — impressive (a.给人深刻印象的): A visitor looks upward in admiration at a magnificent tall cathedral interior, wide eyes and small human scale.
CROP SAFETY: scale every scene down enough to leave 15% whitespace inside EACH cell. Bottom-row subjects including heads and hair start BELOW 58% of total canvas height. Keep all heads, hands and main objects entirely visible.
review_notes: All four cells visually checked for subject/sense and crop boundaries. Medical symbols, maritime parts/actions, time period and globe concept legible.
